agent_discovery.description: Answer a bounded visual question from one current RGB camera frame through the configured vision-language router. Use this read-only Skill when visible evidence is sufficient; it reports backend provenance and uncertainty and does not infer depth or move the robot.
when_to_use: The user asks a visual question about the current camera scene.
A finite Skill needs one routed VLM interpretation with backend provenance.
when_not_to_use: The task requires metric depth, a registered 3D point, continuous tracking, or physical motion.
Deterministic geometry or a non-VLM sensor can answer more reliably.
side_effects: Reads one current RGB frame from provider shared memory.
Calls one configured VLM backend, with ordered fallback on failure.

question.description: The complete bounded question about visible evidence.
